sn14.35:1.1: Sāvatthi || || I Yo bhikkhave pathavīdhātum abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati || Yo dukkham abhinandati aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || Yo āpodhātum abhinandati || pe|| || Yo tejodhātum abhinandati || pe|| || Yo vāyodhātum abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati || Yo dukkham abhinandati aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || II
sn14.35:2.1: Yo ca kho bhikkhave pathavīdhātuṃ nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati || yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati parimutto so dukkhasmāti vadāmi || || Yo āpodhātuṃ || pe|| || Yo tejodhātuṃ || pe|| || Yo vāyodhātum nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati || yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati parimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || Chaṭṭhaṃ || ||
